description: Run autonomous end-to-end discovery: extract the app domain from source, classify the app type, generate scenarios with edge-case variants, drive them through Playwright, and return a compact summary. Requires a running dev server (baseUrl optional, auto-detected if omitted). Writes HTML/JSON reports to sniff-reports/discovery/.

appType.description: Filter classifier guesses to these app types (does NOT bypass classification; use forceAppType for that)

baseUrl.description: URL of the running app. Optional -- sniff auto-detects localhost servers if omitted.

dryRun.description: Generate scenarios + classify without launching a browser or writing reports. Useful for preview.

forceAppType.description: Force a single app type, bypassing the classifier entirely. Use when classification returns blank.

only.description: Filter scenarios by id substring or app type

realism.description: Realism profile (default: robot in CI, casual-user otherwise)

rootDir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

name: sniff_discover
